name: screenshot-ocr
title: Screenshot OCR
description: Take a screenshot of your desktop, connect it to an OCR text model, and set the recognized text to your last clipboard copy.
author: morgan_titcher

commands.name: copy
commands.title: Copy OCR Text
commands.subtitle: (⌘C) Copy recognized text to clipboard.
commands.description: Takes a screenshot of your desktop, applies OCR to the image, and copies the recognized text to your clipboard. Use ⌘V to paste.

commands.name: copyAndPaste
commands.title: Copy OCR Text and Paste
commands.description: Capture region, apply OCR, copy the recognized text to your clipboard, and paste it into the frontmost app automatically.

commands.name: openPreferences
commands.title: Open OCR Preferences
commands.description: Open the extension preferences for Screenshot OCR.

commands.name: toggleAutoPaste
commands.title: Toggle Auto Paste (⌘V after OCR)
commands.description: Toggle whether to paste the recognized text automatically after copying.

commands.name: copyLastResult
commands.title: Copy Last OCR Result
commands.description: Copy the last recognized OCR text to the clipboard and show a snippet HUD.

commands.name: demoGallery
commands.title: Demo Gallery
commands.description: Browse demo scenarios for Screenshot OCR functionality.

commands.name: lastOcrResult
commands.title: Last OCR Result
commands.description: View the last OCR result with metadata and copy options.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot OCR
tools.description: AI tool for screenshot OCR analysis. Use @screenshot-ocr in Raycast AI to analyze screenshots, extract text, or answer questions about image content. Takes screenshots, applies OCR, and provides AI-powered analysis of the extracted text.

preferences.name: ocrProvider
preferences.title: OCR Provider
preferences.description: Select the OCR backend to use.

preferences.name: ocrSpaceApiKey
preferences.title: API Keys
preferences.label: OCR.Space API Key
preferences.description: Optional. If empty, the demo key is used and heavily rate-limited.

preferences.name: includeCursor
preferences.title: Screenshot Options
preferences.label: Include Cursor in Screenshot
preferences.description: If enabled, the system cursor is visible in captured screenshots.

preferences.name: autoPaste
preferences.title: After Copy
preferences.label: Paste immediately after OCR
preferences.description: If enabled, the recognized text will be pasted into the frontmost app automatically. Disabled by default for better control.

preferences.name: ocrLanguage
preferences.title: OCR Language
preferences.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code, e.g., 'eng' for English. Defaults to 'eng'.

preferences.name: postprocessText
preferences.title: Post-Processing
preferences.label: Apply Heuristic Cleanup
preferences.description: Fix common OCR artifacts (quotes, dashes, ligatures, spacing).

preferences.name: useAIRefinement
preferences.title: Post-Processing (AI)
preferences.label: Use Raycast AI to Refine Text (Raycast Pro)
preferences.description: If enabled and configured, uses Raycast AI to clean up OCR text.

preferences.name: aiRefinementPrompt
preferences.title: AI Refinement Prompt
preferences.description: Override the default instruction for AI-based cleanup.

preferences.name: useLocalAI
preferences.title: Ollama (Local AI)
preferences.label: Use Local Ollama for Refining Text
preferences.description: If enabled and configured, use a local LLM to clean up OCR text.

preferences.name: ollamaUrl
preferences.title: Ollama URL
preferences.description: Base URL to the Ollama server.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
